facts.text: The hotel is in Munich's city center, directly opposite the Central Train Station.
facts.excerpt: Our Munich hotel in the city center, and directly opposite the Central Train Station

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Oktoberfest fairgrounds.
facts.excerpt: Le Méridien Munich is walking distance from the fair grounds

facts.text: The Theresienwiese festival grounds are within a 10-minute walk of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: within 10 minutes' walk from the hotel you reach the Theresienwiese festival grounds

facts.text: The hotel is a 7-minute walk from Munich's beer festival.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is only 7 Minutes by walk away from Munich’s Beer Festival.

facts.text: Curated design elements of contemporary art surround guests in the lobby.
facts.excerpt: Entering our lobby area, curated design elements of contemporary art will surround you.

facts.text: Through the Unlock Art program, hotel guests get complimentary access to MUCA, Germany's first museum dedicated to urban and contemporary art.
facts.excerpt: our hotel guests enjoy complimentary access to Germany's first museum dedicated to urban and contemporary art: the MUCA - Museum of Urban and Contemporary Art

facts.text: MUCA is a short walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: just a short footwalk from the hotel

facts.text: Guests can enjoy a complimentary visit to the Kunstlabor.
facts.excerpt: enjoy a complimentary visit to the Kunstlabor

facts.text: The LM Hub lobby offers views to the green courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Take a seat and be inspired by curated design, views to the green courtyard and Munich itself

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and views of the city or of the green courtyard.
facts.excerpt: floor-to-ceiling windows, contemporary interior, views of the city or into the calm green courtyard

facts.text: Rooms measure a minimum of 28 square meters (301 square feet).
facts.excerpt: with minimum 28m² / 301sqft

facts.text: The hotel says its rooms are among the largest in the city.
facts.excerpt: the hotel rooms at Le Méridien Munich are among the largest in the city

facts.text: Rooms have acoustic insulation and blackout curtains.
facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows, acoustic insulation, and blackout curtains support restful sleep.

facts.text: The Junior Suite has a walk-in closet.
facts.excerpt: the cozy Junior Suite with walk-in closet

facts.text: The Executive Suite has a separate living room and a guest bathroom.
facts.excerpt: The large Executive Suite has separate living room + guest bathroom

facts.text: Le SPA Munich covers 750 square meters, with massages, facials, a pool and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: Le SPA Munich is a 750 m2 oasis in the heart of the city, with massages, facials, a pool, and a sauna after busy days.

facts.text: The spa uses Babor products.
facts.excerpt: treatments from all over the world, and Babor products

facts.text: The hotel has an indoor heated pool.
facts.excerpt: Indoor Heated Pool

facts.text: The hotel says it has one of the longest hotel pools in town.
facts.excerpt: Le Méridien Munich offers one of the longest Hotel Pools in Town

facts.text: The gym is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
facts.excerpt: Gym area opened 24/7

facts.text: IRMI is a modern Bavarian restaurant in the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Irmi Munich is a modern Bavarian restaurant in the heart of the hotel

facts.text: In the warm months the hotel's courtyard becomes IRMI's beer garden.
facts.excerpt: In the warm and sunny months, you can enjoy autumn outside, when the courtyard at Le Méridien hotel Munich transforms into Irmi's beer garden.

facts.text: IRMI serves locally brewed Giesinger beer on draught.
facts.excerpt: locally brewed - and freshly draught - Giesinger beer

facts.text: Bar Longitude 11° serves cocktails and snacks.
facts.excerpt: Snacks are also served in the bar within a warm and inviting setting.

facts.text: The breakfast restaurant has direct access to the green garden.
facts.excerpt: Flooded by daylight with direct access to the green garden

facts.text: Stachus Square, the entrance to Munich's pedestrian area, is 5 minutes from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: 5 minutes to this vibrant square, marking Munich’s pedestrian area entrance.

facts.text: The Eisbach surfers in the English Garden are 20 minutes from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Only 20 minutes to see surfers riding waves in the English Garden.

facts.text: Munich Central Station across the street makes day trips to lakes, mountains and Neuschwanstein Castle easy.
facts.excerpt: with Munich Central Station across the street for day trips to lakes, mountains, and Neuschwanstein Castle

facts.text: Munich Airport is about 35 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Distance from Property: 35.0 KM

facts.text: Cash payment is not possible anywhere in the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Please note that cash payment is not possible throughout the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel accepts cash and credit cards.
facts.excerpt: Accepts: Cash, Credit Cards

facts.text: Pets are welcome.
facts.excerpt: Pets Welcome.
